# AUDIO PROFILE
Sandra, a working-class woman from Bolton, Lancashire in her fifties, married to Derek for thirty years.

## THE SCENE
Inside the machine's building: a vast, silent, spotless clean room, white and futuristic, a hundred people in white suits settling into chairs they know they will not get up from. A soft, dead, hushed acoustic, no echo; voices close and quiet.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Emotion for this line: soft and fond, lying back in the chair, holding his hand; a smile in her voice holding back tears; 'Before the world ended' light, the joke is how she says goodbye.
Style: sharp, sarcastic, every line a jab; not shouting at first, then loud. Funny because she is completely serious.
Pace: quick and clipped.
Accent: Northern English, as heard in Lancashire, around Bolton. Never American, never Received Pronunciation.

### SAMPLE CONTEXT
The voice you'd cast as the wife in a British sitcom row that the whole street can hear.
